descriptions.zh:
虚空虫瘟疫正在肆虐。

这些生物不再将宿主星球作为繁殖地。我们必须消灭它们，否则我们的殖民地将面临风险。

§Y每消灭一个虚空虫都会加速局势进展。§!
descriptions.en:
A plague of Voidworms is upon us.

These creatures will no longer spare host planets as breeding grounds. We must work to eradicate them or our colonies will be at risk.

§YEach Voidworm destroyed accelerates Situation progress.§!

descriptions.zh: 来自§Y黑针§!的大量破坏分子潜伏在我们之中，在[owner.GetName]各地造成广泛破坏。除非我们消灭这些破坏分子，否则破坏将持续下去，直到我们的补给线崩溃。
descriptions.en: A vast network of saboteurs from the §YBlack Needle§! is hidden among us causing widespread disruption across [owner.GetName]. Unless we eliminate the saboteurs, the damage will continue until our supply lines collapse.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一个巨大的、明显发生过变异的虚空虫的巢穴。它们具有高度的攻击倾向，并且似乎能够以非寄生方式繁殖。

我们的存在似乎激怒了它们的巢穴。我们必须谨慎行事。

[GetVoidwormsHostility]
descriptions.en:
We discovered a large hive of obviously mutated Voidworms. They exist in a heightened state of aggression, and apparently have the ability to reproduce in a non-parasitic manner.

Our presence seems to be agitating their nests. We must proceed with caution.

[GetVoidwormsHostility]
